transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we get into the enforcement package for the competitor's product, I need to follow our standard pre-filing huddle protocol. I'll need a current report from conflicts counsel and from the patent-commercialization lead before I can give final approval on any filing or demand. Can we start with those updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed a conflicts check yesterday and found a significant issue. The competitor's parent company is a current firm client in an unrelated matter. Under our firm's conflicts policy, we cannot send a demand or file suit until we obtain written informed consent from both clients and document an ethical screen. I have not yet entered this result into the litigation intake system.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an important business constraint that hasn't been incorporated into the enforcement draft yet. In this week's product commercialization meeting, I confirmed that the company's approved business objective is to preserve interoperability with compliant implementations of API v2. This means the demand must request a royalty-free interoperability license limited to API v2 and must NOT seek an injunction against compliant API v2 implementations. This objective has not yet been added to the draft complaint or the proposed pre-suit demand letter, so those documents will need to be revised before any approval.
